page.overview:
Who is Sakura's son?

Sakura's son appeared in her ending in Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter.

While not much is known about Sakura's son, he is shown to have a curious personality and shares Sakura's brown hair and hairstyle. He also wears a blue shirt and has brown eyes. Interestingly, he has a band aid on his left elbow and right cheek, possibly coming from practice spars with his mother. Category:Characters Category:Marvel Vs.
